```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(Biobase)
library(limma)
library(sva)
```

```{r montpick data}

# Load data
# ------------
con = url("http://bowtie-bio.sourceforge.net/recount/ExpressionSets/montpick_eset.RData")
load(file = con)
close(con)

# Rename expression set object
mp = montpick.eset

# Extract phenotype/sample metadata
pdata=  pData(mp)

# Extract the gene expression matrix and convert it into a data frame
edata = as.data.frame(exprs(mp))

# Extract feature metadata 
fdata = fData(mp)
```


```{r Q1}

# Function to calculate percentage of variance explained by PC1
# --------------------------------------------------------------
pc1_variance = function(data, center_data = TRUE) {
  
  # Perform PCA on samples (transpose so samples are rows and genes are columns)
  pca = prcomp(t(data), center = center_data, scale. = FALSE)
  
  # Calculate percentage of total variance explained by the first principal component
  pc1 = (pca$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) * 100
  
  return(pc1)}

# Apply function
# ---------------

# No transformation
pc1_no_transform = pc1_variance(edata, center_data = FALSE)


# Log2(data + 1) transformation
edata_log = log2(edata + 1)
pc1_log = pc1_variance(edata_log, center_data = FALSE)


# Log2(data + 1) transformation, subtract row means
edata_log_centered = edata_log - rowMeans(edata_log)
pc1_log_centered = pc1_variance(edata_log_centered)


# Results
# ---------------
(results = data.frame(
  Transformation = c(
    "No transformation",
    "log2(data + 1)",
    "log2(data + 1) + subtract row means"),
  PC1_Variance_Percent = c(
    pc1_no_transform,
    pc1_log,
    pc1_log_centered)))

```


```{r Q2}

# Log2(data + 1) transform and subtract row means
# ------------------------------------------------
edata_log = log2(edata + 1)

# Subtract each gene's mean expression across samples
edata_centered = edata_log - rowMeans(edata_log)


# Cluster samples using k-means
# ------------------------------

# Transpose so samples are rows and genes are columns
sample_data = t(edata_centered)

set.seed(333)

# Perform k-means clustering into two groups
km = kmeans(sample_data, centers = 2)

# Extract sample cluster assignments
cluster_indicator = km$cluster


# Perform SVD
# --------------
svd_result = svd(sample_data)

first_singular_vector = svd_result$u[,1]


# Calculate correlation between singular vector and cluster indicator
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
(correlation = cor(first_singular_vector, cluster_indicator))

```

```{r bodymap data}

# Load data
# ------------
con = url("http://bowtie-bio.sourceforge.net/recount/ExpressionSets/bodymap_eset.RData")
load(file = con)
close(con)

# Rename expression set object
bm = bodymap.eset

# Extract the gene expression matrix
edata = exprs(bm)

# Extract phenotype/sample metadata
pdata_bm = pData(bm)

```

```{r Q3}

# Extract the first gene's counts
gene1 = edata[1, ]

# Extract number of technical replicates from sample metadata
replicates = factor(pdata_bm$num.tech.reps)

# Fit linear model treating replicates as a factor
model = lm(gene1 ~ replicates)

# Display model summary
summary(model)

# Plot first gene counts versus technical replicates
plot(replicates, gene1,
  xlab = "Number of Technical Replicates",
  ylab = "First Gene Counts",
  main = "First Gene Counts vs Technical Replicates")

# Add fitted values from the linear model
points(
  unique(replicates),
  fitted(model)[match(unique(replicates), replicates)],
  col = "red",
  pch = 19)

```

```{r Q4}

# Extract the first gene's counts
gene1 = edata[1, ]

# Check the available phenotype variables
colnames(pdata_bm)

# Fit linear model relating first gene counts to age and sex
model_age_gender = lm(gene1 ~ age + gender, data = pdata_bm)

# View model results
summary(model_age_gender)

# Extract coefficient for age
(age_coefficient <- summary(model_age_gender)$coefficients["age", "Estimate"])

```

```{r Q5}

# Reload montpick data

# Perform log2(data + 1) transformation
edata_log = log2(edata + 1)

# Create design matrix using population (with intercept)
X = model.matrix(~ population, data = pdata)

# Fit linear model to all genes using lm.fit
fit = lm.fit(x = X, y = t(edata_log))

# Display dimensions of output matrices
(results = data.frame(
  Matrix = c(
    "No Residual",
    "Effects",
    "Coefficients"),
  dim = c(
    dim(fit$residuals),
    dim(fit$effects),
    dim(fit$coefficients))))

```

```{r Q7}

# Load bodymap data

# Keep only samples with non-missing age values
keep <- !is.na(pdata_bm$age)

# Subset the expression matrix to the selected samples
edata_sub <- edata[, keep]

# Subset the phenotype data to the selected samples
pdata_sub <- pdata_bm[keep, ]

# Create the design matrix with an intercept and age predictor
design <- model.matrix(~ age, data = pdata_sub)

# Fit a linear model for every gene
fit <- lmFit(edata_sub, design)

# Display the coefficient for age for the 1000th gene
fit$coefficients[1000, "age"]

# Extract the expression values for the 1000th gene
gene <- edata_sub[1000, ]

# Extract the corresponding age values
age <- pdata_sub$age

# Plot gene expression vs age
plot(age, gene,
     xlab = "Age",
     ylab = "Expression",
     main = "Gene 1000")

# Add the fitted regression line to the plot
abline(a = fit$coefficients[1000, "(Intercept)"],
       b = fit$coefficients[1000, "age"],
       col = "red",
       lwd = 2)
```

```{r Q8}

# Repeat from Q7, only run if skipping that block ----------
# Keep only samples with non-missing age values
keep <- !is.na(pdata_bm$age)

# Subset the expression matrix to the selected samples
edata_sub <- edata[, keep]

# Subset the phenotype data to the selected samples
pdata_sub <- pdata_bm[keep, ]
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Create the design matrix with age as the outcome and tissue type as an adjustment variable
design <- model.matrix(~ tissue.type + age, data = pdata_sub)

# Fit a linear model for every gene
fit <- lmFit(edata_sub, design)

# Display the coefficients for the 1,000th gene
fit$coefficients[1000, ]

```

```{r Q10}

set.seed(33353)

# Repeat from Q7, only run if skipping that block ----------
# Keep samples with non-missing age
keep <- !is.na(pdata_bm$age)

# Subset expression and phenotype data
edata_sub <- edata[, keep]
pdata_sub <- pdata_bm[keep, ]
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Log2 transform the expression data
edata_log <- log2(edata_sub + 1)

# Remove genes with low average expression
edata_log <- edata_log[rowMeans(edata_log) >= 1, ]

# Create the model matrix with age as the outcome variable
mod <- model.matrix(~ age, data = pdata_sub)

# Create the null model without age
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = pdata_sub)

# Estimate one surrogate variable
svobj <- sva(edata_log, mod, mod0, n.sv = 1)

# Extract the estimated surrogate variable
sv <- svobj$sv[, 1]

# Create a data frame containing correlations between surrogate variable and covariates
(results = data.frame(
  Variable = c("Age", "Race", "Gender"),
  Correlation = c(
    cor(sv, pdata_sub$age),
    cor(sv, as.numeric(as.factor(pdata_sub$race))),
    cor(sv, as.numeric(as.factor(pdata_sub$gender)))
  )))
```
